findings.message: tasks.md 6.3 claims `main_page_states_unit.steps.tsx` and `locations_storage_ui_unit.steps.tsx` build page states with `test/registryOverride.ts`, `test/viewFixtures.tsx`, `test/localStorageMock.ts`; in the repo only `main_page/steps/main_page_states_unit.steps.tsx`, `main_page_unit.steps.ts` and `main_page_view_host_unit.steps.tsx` use them — `locations_storage_ui_unit.steps.tsx` uses none. Fix the reference.

Test placement: tasks 5.2 (`DateBar.test.tsx`: focus is `document.activeElement` after Now, live-region announcement) and 5.4 (`CalendarDialog.test.tsx`: ArrowDown/ArrowRight/Enter, ArrowRight crossing the month, Esc, `aria-selected`/`aria-current`/`tabIndex`) test keyboard, aria and focus in jsdom. bdd-unit.md's table says 'Keyboard accessibility | no | yes' and 'aria-labels, focus management | no | yes' (E2E only), and the acceptance criterion requires 'keyboard, layout, real-browser behaviour in E2E, not in jsdom'. Task 6.2 itself defers aria/focus to 7.1, which already covers these. Move or drop them from the jsdom tasks.

design.md D1 puts `Temporal.PlainDate`/`Temporal.Instant` objects into the `SET_DATE`/`SHIFT_DATE` commands and explicitly rejects ISO strings. Accepted ADR-0002 says 'Commands — serializable objects with a `type` discriminator' and 'Commands as data enable logging, undo and deterministic replay in tests'. Temporal objects only stringify one way (`toJSON`), so replaying logged commands breaks. Carry ISO strings (`2026-03-08`, `2026-03-08T07:30:00Z`) and parse them in the reducer, or settle the exception in a new ADR rather than in design.md.

Accepted ADR-0003 'Wall-clock input and DST' says for `GAP` 'moved forward to 03:30; the view tells the user' (and for `AMBIGUOUS` 'the view may offer the later one'). This change lets date moves land in gaps and overlaps (FR4, M3) but NG2/Q1 decide 'no text', so the user is not told. Either show the status in this change or refer the deferral to `docs/adr/` (new or superseding ADR) instead of settling it locally.

The `main-page` delta modifies the scenarios 'User opens the app' (adds 'the bottom bar shows the date bar') and 'Notices stay available' (adds 'the notice is above the bottom bar'), but no task updates them in `src/test/features/main_page/main_page_unit.feature`. There they still end at 'the content region shows the active view' / 'announced politely in the notices region' with only `@add-main-page-scaffold` tags. Task 7.3 adds a different scenario ('Notice above the bar'). Add tasks that update these scenarios (unit or e2e as placement requires) with `@select-date-with-calendar-and-now @FR8`.

Minor traceability: task 6.2 tags the calendar scenarios including 'March 2026 in English and Russian' with `@FR10`, which is unrelated to the out-of-range rule; tag only the range scenario with `@FR10`.

findings.message: design.md D2 (and FR4's claim of 'compatible disambiguation, ADR-0003') contradicts Accepted ADR-0003, section 'Wall-clock input and DST', which says converting a wall-clock time to an instant 'always passes an explicit `disambiguation: "compatible"` and reports a status'. D2 instead converts twice with `disambiguation: "earlier"` and `"later"`, picks later on a gap and earlier on an overlap, and never passes "compatible". That replaces the ADR's prescribed method with a local decision in design.md instead of referring it to docs/adr/. Fix: resolve the pinned instant with `toZonedDateTime(zone, { disambiguation: "compatible" })`, keep the earlier/later conversions only to classify UNIQUE/GAP/AMBIGUOUS, and update D2 and task 2.1; or record the replacement in a new ADR that supersedes this part of ADR-0003 and have D2 refer to it.

findings.message: UX2, UX3 and the calendar-layout part of NFR-R2 have no automated test that verifies them. test-planning.md rule 1: "Every FR/NFR/UX from proposal must have at least one automated test covering it". traceability.md / antipatterns.md: "Vague traceability ... If the reference is not explicit, it does not exist." Task 7.1 adds the tags `@UX2`, `@UX3` to "Bar on a narrow screen", "Bar on a wide screen", "Last card above the bar", "Touch targets" and "No horizontal scrolling", but none of these spec scenarios (specs/date-selection/spec.md, "Date bar layout") asserts that Now is "the accent-filled button with a clock icon and the label" or that the arrows are icon buttons (UX2), or that "The date text in the bar is the most prominent text of the bar and uses the main foreground colour" (UX3). The spec requirement text does not even state UX3 although its comment claims `implements ... UX3`. NFR-R2's "The calendar is full screen below 640 px and a centered dialog from 640 px" has no scenario and no task step. Add E2E scenarios and steps that assert these, and state UX3 in the spec requirement.

NFR-A2 is only partly covered. The proposal says "Tab reaches previous day, date, next day and Now in that order; Enter and Space activate them" and "Enter or Space picks the focused day", and the spec requirement "Keyboard-operable date selection" repeats this. No scenario in specs/date-selection/spec.md or task 7.1 checks the Tab order across all four controls ("Next day and Now with the keyboard" only says "tabs to the next-day button" and "tabs to Now"), and no scenario uses Space. Add E2E steps that assert the focus order previous day → date → next day → Now and that Space activates a bar control and a calendar day.

Feature file naming violates .claude/rules/bdd-unit.md: "The `_unit` suffix is added only when a paired `_e2e` file exists for the same aspect". The proposal's Behavior section and tasks 6.2 and 6.3 create `date_selection_calendar_unit.feature` and `date_selection_date_bar_unit.feature`, but no `date_selection_calendar_e2e.feature` or `date_selection_date_bar_e2e.feature` is planned; the only E2E files are `date_selection_e2e.feature` and `date_selection_view_contract_e2e.feature`. The repo follows this convention elsewhere (`locations_ui_unit`/`locations_ui_e2e`, `locations_local_time_unit`/`locations_local_time_e2e`). Rename them to `date_selection_calendar.feature` and `date_selection_date_bar.feature` (and their steps files), or split the E2E feature by matching aspect.
